Subject: Request: Redwood demo + capacity & SSO questions

Hi Marissa,

We just signed up for the self-serve trial (acct id: shoply-4221) and I'm evaluating Redwood for a customer support + semantic search use case. Before we lock in a demo, could you share a bit about expected throughput you can support in the hosted offering, typical per-token costs for the chat endpoint, and whether Redwood supports SSO + EU data locality?

High-level background:
- Company: Shoply (e-commerce marketplace, US + EU customers)
- Use case: FAQ/CS bot + re-ranking for site search
- Expected pilot: 100–200 concurrent requests at peak, ~100–150 tokens per request
- Timeline: aim to run a 6–8 week pilot starting Jan 2027

Would love a short demo next week if we can align; my calendar is fairly open on Tue/Wed afternoons PST.

Thanks,

Eleanor Park
Head of Platform
Shoply
eleanor@shoply.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor@shoply.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood demo + capacity & SSO questions

Hi Eleanor — thanks for signing up and for the context, this is helpful. I can absolutely run a short demo and cover throughput/costs and our SSO/GDPR posture. Before we schedule, a few quick clarifying questions so I can tailor the session and have the right folks on the call: 

1) Primary demo goals: is the priority response latency for live chat, cost-per-query for search reranking, or both?
2) Peak concurrency: you noted 100–200 concurrent — is that sustained for several minutes or spikes for short bursts (e.g., Black Friday)?
3) Average tokens per request: you said ~100–150 — is that input+output combined?
4) Monthly estimate: do you have an order-of-magnitude expected monthly token volume for the pilot?
5) Compliance: you mentioned EU data locality — do you need EU-only hosting for pilot data, or just encryption + contractual safeguards? Any certifications required (SOC 2, ISO)?
6) Technical contacts: who from infra/security should join the call (to cover SSO/SAML & data handling)?

If you can reply with those answers I’ll pull in our solutions engineer and a security SME for the demo. I also have the following slots available — pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite: 
- Tue Dec 7, 11:00 AM PST
- Wed Dec 8, 2:00 PM PST
- Fri Dec 10, 9:00 AM PST

Attaching our pre-demo checklist so you know what we'll touch on.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise SDR
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.pdf

From: Eleanor Park <eleanor@shoply.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Redwood demo + capacity & SSO questions

Hi Marissa — great, answers below: 

1) Primary goal: both, but prioritize low-latency chat for our CS workflow; reranking is secondary for the pilot.
2) Peak concurrency: expect short spikes up to ~200 concurrent requests (a few minutes), baseline ~40–60 concurrent.
3) Tokens per request: ~120 tokens avg (input+output).
4) Monthly estimate: pilot ~150–200M tokens/month; expansion could grow to ~1B in production.
5) Compliance: EU-only hosting is required for EU customer data during pilot; SOC 2 Type II is required within procurement for enterprise pilots.
6) Technical contacts: cc'ing our Lead Infra (matthew@shoply.com) and Security (olivia@shoply.com) — please include them on the invite.

Wed Dec 8, 2:00 PM PST works for me. Please send an invite.

Thanks,

Eleanor

Attachments: gdpr-security-questions.pdf

Team — forwarding inbound from Shoply (Eleanor). Quick summary:
- Use case: CS chat (priority) + search reranking
- Pilot timeline: Jan 2027, 6–8 week pilot
- Traffic: spikes to ~200 concurrent for short bursts, ~120 tokens/request, est. 150–200M tokens/month for pilot
- Requirements: EU-only hosting for EU customer data, SOC 2 Type II required; technical contacts (matthew/olivia) to be included on the invite

Can one of you lead the demo on Wed Dec 8 2:00 PM PST? Things I'd like prepped:
- Recommended model(s) (hosted vs dedicated) given the token volumes and spikes
- Suggested batching/caching strategy and expected per-token cost ranges for pilot (ballpark)
- Any blockers for EU-only pilot and what the Right path is (Dedicated vs hosted with regional routing)
- Security collateral: where to find SOC2 evidence / documentation for procurement team

Attaching the traffic snapshot they sent. ETA: I'll send the calendar invite with Eleanor + matthew/olivia once you confirm availability.

Thanks — Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Redwood demo + capacity & SSO questions

Thanks for the heads-up, Marissa — happy to take this. I can run the technical demo and cover throughput/architecture:
- Recommend starting on hosted with regional routing to EU for their EU data (low-friction pilot). If they need strict isolation, move to Dedicated for the production ramp.
- For spikes to 200 concurrent: plan for request-level autoscaling + prefix/KV caching for common prompts. We should show a quick perf simulation and an estimate for per-token unit cost under their expected batching profile.
- Model rec: start with a quantized mid/large variant (redwood-2-preview-large-quant) for cost/latency balance; pull in Steph for batching/kernel tuning suggestions.

I can join Wed Dec 8, 2:00 PM PST. @Stephanie — can you bring a short slide on batching/latency tradeoffs and a rough cost calc?

Ben

ben@redwood.ai
